if: the supply is a taxable supply of services
an invoice under rule 46 is required
the supplier is not an insurer, banking company or financial institution including a non-banking financial company
then: the invoice MUST be issued within thirty days from the date of the supply of service
note: Rule 47 fixes a time limit for SERVICES only. UNKNOWN — the time limit for a supply of GOODS is set by section 31 of the CGST Act, which is a different document and was not read for this record.

evidence.quote: 47. Time limit for issuing tax invoice.- The invoice referred to in rule 46, in the case of the taxable supply of services, shall be issued within a period of thirty days from the date of the supply of service:
